title: filenode-server: FileNode/set update accepts a parentId naming no node
description: Found during JMAP-y1yu.8 (2026-11-16). draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-20 §3.1.1: 'The parent MUST be a node whose @type permits children'. handle_filenode_set's update path checks self-parent, cycles and maxFileNodeDepth for a new parentId but not that the parent exists (or permits children): {"update": {"d3": {"parentId": "nope"}}} succeeds and leaves d3 dangling (and invisible to tree walks). Under atomic the memory backend's commit check (final_state_failures) rejects a dangling parent with invalidProperties [parentId]; the non-atomic path does not. Fix in the update path: fetch the new parent, invalidProperties [parentId] when it is missing or its @type has no children (check how create validates parentId and reuse it), plus tests.
